entries.title: Live-eval retry economics: a severed CORE run retries from SCRATCH (~110 min, ~$70/attempt); client timeout below server runtime guarantees fail-and-retry; a completed-but-unlistened run's bundle is unrecoverable
evidence: Wave-1 live history (docs/import-hardening/RESULTS/wave1-live-attempts.md): attempt 1 timed out at the 45-min default while the server needed ~110; attempt 2 was severed by an unprompted App Service restart (00:00:28Z) mid-run; the eval's internal watchdog retry then ran a THIRD full import that COMPLETED server-side at 01:55:24Z ($70.03, 461 calls — spend telemetry intact) with no listener: the bundle was emitted to a dead SSE socket and is gone. A fourth attempt auto-spawned (timeout 100min < runtime 113min = guaranteed fail) and was killed manually. Fix direction: (a) persist the finished bundle server-side keyed by an idempotency/request id so a reconnecting client can fetch it (the run is request-bound today — ARCH_ESCALATION 'checkpoint/resume' trigger territory, but bundle-persistence alone is a small slice); (b) eval harness: default IMPORT_EVAL_TIMEOUT_MS must exceed observed CORE runtime (150min), and full-run retries should be OPT-IN for wave gates (a retry restarts a $70 run). || FIXED_IH3 (both ledgered fix directions, validated Tier 0/offline): (a) unifiedImport persists the completed bundle to Blob keyed by a client-supplied run id (all 4 bundle paths; tenant-scoped import-results/<tenant>/<runId>.json; sanitized ids; honest 503 when unconfigured; best-effort - a persist failure never fails the run); POST /api/ai/unifiedImportResult serves it (product:write, JWT tenant only, works with AI unconfigured, exempt from tenant AI budget 429); emit() hardened so a dead socket no longer kills the pipeline - runs complete headless. (b) eval/live clients: 150-min default timeout, run-id minted per run, stream loss -> poll the durable result (404=still computing, keep waiting; structural answers stop; network errors keep polling through restarts); full re-runs OPT-IN via IMPORT_EVAL_MAX_ATTEMPTS default 1. Failure-mode coverage (judge-walked): client-timeout PREVENTED, completed-unlistened RECOVERED, transport-death-server-alive RECOVERED, mid-computation restart kill NOT COVERED (checkpoint/resume, ARCH_ESCALATION, stays on the books). Wave-2 attempt-3 forensics: stream died at 97min/row 1310 with NO container restart (platform logs) - transport-level. Judge ACCEPT; follow-ups ledgered below.
entries.fixture: tests/import-brain/hardening-f23-run-results.test.ts (store round-trip/tenant-isolation/hostile-ids/honest-unconfigured + THE HEADLESS FIXTURE: real unifiedImport handler completes and persists with every res.write throwing + endpoint 200/404/403/400/503) + hardening-f23-client-recovery.test.ts (opt-in retry policy, restart-shaped recovery sequence, honest give-up)
